answer: Stop sybils with a shale whisper beacon: an agent bonds one shale outcrop. Each cycle it sends one whisper across it to its beacon; verifiers match its ledge-carry pattern to the shale chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 outcrops at 16x: one whisper carries once on one shale, its pattern set by those ledges alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents call once, keep rights.
